SELECT /* isry.couns.constt.bbsnav.mapper.BbsnavListMapper.getTotalCount : 네이버게시판 게시글 수 */ COUNT(*) FROM AYE100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시판유형구분코드 */ AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL )
AND AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = #{CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 위기유형구분 조회 */
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} || '%' /* 게시글 고유번호 조회 */
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} || '%' /* 게시글 제목 조회 */
AND C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) LIKE '%' || #{WRTR_NM_ENCPT} || '%' /* 작성자 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD IS NULL /* 문제상태미등록 */
AND AA.RETE_DLIV_CMPTN_YN = #{RETE_DLIV_CMPTN_YN}
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1

SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbssimListMapper.selectBbssoldList : 본인상담게시판 */ AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ , ( SELECT MAX(RETE_ESNTAL_NO) FROM AYE120 T1 WHERE T1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND T1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS RETE_ESNTAL_NO /* 답글고유번호 */ , ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD ) AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_NM /* 상담실적구분 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글 제목명 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRT_DT /* 작성일자 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 작성자명 */ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS WRTR_ID /* 작성자아이디 */ , CC.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD /* 위기유형구분명 */ , ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD ) AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제상태대분류구분코드 */ , ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD ) AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제원인대분류구분코드 */ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE120 z WHERE z.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND z.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND z.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS RETE /* 답글수 */
, AA.RETE_DLIV_CMPTN_YN AS RETE_DLIV_CMPTN_YN /* 답글전달 확인여부 */
, COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM AYE100 AA , SAC100 CC , SAC100 EE WHERE 1=1 AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL )
AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시글유형구분코드 */
AND CC.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) = 'CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD' /* 위기유형구분코드 */ AND CC.CMMNS_CD_VALUE(+) = AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD AND EE.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) = 'BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD' /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ AND EE.CMMNS_CD_VALUE(+) = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD
AND AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = #{CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 위기유형구분 조회 */
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} || '%' /* 게시글 고유번호 조회 */
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} || '%' /* 게시글 제목 조회 */
AND C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) LIKE '%' || #{WRTR_NM_ENCPT} || '%' /* 작성자 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD IS NULL /* 문제상태미등록 */
AND AA.RETE_DLIV_CMPTN_YN = #{RETE_DLIV_CMPTN_YN}
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
ORDER BY AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO DESC , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

/* * isry.couns.constt.bbsnav.mapper.BbsnavListMapper.selectBbsnavDetail : 기타상담게시판 원글(AYE100) 상세 * 2023.04.14 수정 : 불필요한 컬럼 삭제 - Jeong.Won.Je */ SELECT AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글제목 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 작성자명 */ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS WRTR_ID /* 작성자아이디 */
, AA.HPGE_URL_ADDR AS HPGE_URL_ADDR /* 홈페이지URL주소 */
, AA.BBSCTT_CN AS BBSCTT_CN /* 게시글내용 */
, ( SELECT REG_DT FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD ) AS REG_DT /* 상담자배정일자 */ , ( SELECT CONSTT_ID FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD ) AS CONSTT_ID /* 상담자아이디 */ , AA.RETE_DLIV_CMPTN_YN AS RETE_DLIV_CMPTN_YN /* 답글전달완료여부 */
, AA.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD /* 성별 */ , AA.ACBG_SE_CD AS ACBG_SE_CD /* 학력구분코드 */ , AA.GRADE_SE_CD AS GRADE_SE_CD /* 학년구분코드 */ , AA.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD AS GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD /* 졸업상태구분코드 */
, ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD ) AS CRISIS_TYPE_SE_NM /* 위기관리구분명 */
, AA.REAL_CONSTT_SE_CD AS REAL_CONSTT_SE_CD /* 실제상담자구분코드 */ , AA.REAL_CONSTT_ETC_CN AS REAL_CONSTT_ETC_CN /* 실제상담자기타내용 */ , AA.YNGBGS_SE_NO AS YNGBGS_SE_NO /* 청소년구분번호 */ , AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제상태대분류구분코드 */ , AA.PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD /* 문제상태중분류구분코드 */ , AA.PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제상태소분류구분코드 */ , AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제원인대분류구분코드 */ , AA.PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제원인소분류구분코드 */ , AA.ETC_CN AS ETC_CN /* 기타내용 */ , AA.LINK_PRCS_SE_CN AS LINK_PRCS_SE_CN /* 연계처리구분내용 */ , AA.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD /* 접수의뢰경로구분코드 */ , ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD ) AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_NM /* 접수의뢰경로구분명 */ , AA.LINK_INST_NM AS LINK_INST_NM /* 연계기관명 */ FROM AYE100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시판유형구분코드 */ AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL )

/* * isry.couns.constt.bbsnav.mapper.BbsnavListMapper.selectRespodDetail : 기타상담게시판 답글(AYE120) 상세 * 2023.04.14 수정 : 불필요한 컬럼 삭제 - Jeong.Won.Je */ SELECT AA.RETE_ESNTAL_NO AS RETE_ESNTAL_NO /* 답글고유번호 */ , AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ , AA.RETE_CN AS RETE_CN /* 답글내용 */ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디 */ FROM AYE120 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시판유형구분코드 */ AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL )
SELECT COUNT(BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO) FROM AYA110 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}
SELECT COUNT(BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO) FROM AYA120 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}
SELECT MAX(BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO) FROM AYE100 WHERE BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD}
mapper.update: /* * isry.couns.constt.bbsnav.mapper.BbsnavListMapper.deleteBbsnav : 기타상담게시판 원글(AYE100) 삭제 * 2023.04.17 수정 : 게시글유형구분코드 주석 해제 - Jeong.Won.Je */ UPDATE AYE100 SET DEL_YN = 'Y' , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시판유형구분코드 */

/* * isry.couns.constt.bbsnav.mapper.BbsnavListMapper.updateRespod : 기타상담게시판 답글(AYE120) 수정 * 2023.04.17 수정 : 불필요한 컬럼 삭제 - Jeong.Won.Je */ UPDATE AYE120 SET RETE_CN = #{RETE_CN} /* 답글내용 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE 1=1 AND RETE_ESNTAL_NO = #{RETE_ESNTAL_NO}

/* * isry.couns.constt.bbsnav.mapper.BbsnavListMapper.deleteRespod : 네이버게시판 답글삭제 */ UPDATE AYE120 SET DEL_YN = 'Y' , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} WHERE 1=1 AND RETE_ESNTAL_NO = #{RETE_ESNTAL_NO}

UPDATE /* isry.couns.constt.bbsnav.mapper.BbsnavListMapper.bbsnavDtlCnt : 네이버게시판 게시글조회수 */ AYE100 SET RDCNT_NOCS = NVL(RDCNT_NOCS, 0) +1 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD}
mapper.insert: INSERT /* isry.couns.constt.bbsnav.mapper.BbsnavListMapper.insertCrisisBoard : 네이버게시판 위기유형저장 */ INTO AYA110 ( INDEX_SN /* 색인일련번호 */ , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글구분코드 */ , CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD /* 위기유형구분 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( ( SELECT NVL(MAX(INDEX_SN),0) +1 FROM AYA110 ) , #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} , #{CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD} , #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} , SYSDATE , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , SYSDATE )

INSERT /* isry.couns.constt.bbsnav.mapper.BbsnavListMapper.insertCrisisPerson : 네이버게시판 위기유형저장 */ INTO AYA120 ( INDEX_SN /* 색인일련번호 */ , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글구분코드 */ , CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD /* 위기유형구분 */ , CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( ( SELECT NVL(MAX(INDEX_SN),0) +1 FROM AYA120 ) , #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} , #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} , #{CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD} , #{CLIENA_ID} , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} , SYSDATE , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* isry.couns.constt.bbsnav.mapper.BbsnavListMapper.updateCase : 네이버게시판 슈퍼비전등록 */ AYE100 SET SUPV_SLCTN_CASE_YN = #{SUPV_SLCTN_CASE_YN} WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시판유형구분코드 */

UPDATE /* isry.couns.constt.bbsnav.mapper.BbsnavListMapper.updateBbsnavRespod : 네이버게시판 게시글답변등록 */ AYE100 SET ANS_CN = #{ANS_CN} , ANS_NOCS = NVL(ANS_NOCS, 0) +1 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시판유형구분코드 */
UPDATE AYE100 SET ANS_NOCS = NVL(ANS_NOCS, 0) +1 /* ANS_CN */ WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '36' /* 게시판유형구분코드 36:구글 */
mapper.select: /* * isry.couns.constt.bbsnav.mapper.BbsnavListMapper.selectCounselorList : WORK_YMD에 해당하는 근무자 리스트 * 2023.05.10 : 추가 - Jeong.Won.Je */ SELECT DISTINCT C##RG.DEC_B64(BB.FLNM_ENCPT) AS CNSLTNT_NM /* 상담원명 */ , CC.USER_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담원아이디 */ FROM AYC100 AA , SCA100 BB , SAA200 CC WHERE 1=1 AND AA.WORK_YMD = SUBSTR(#{WORK_YMD},0,8) AND AA.USER_ID = CC.USER_ID AND BB.ENFSN_NO = CC.ENFSN_NO AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY C##RG.DEC_B64(BB.FLNM_ENCPT)
mapper.update: /* * isry.couns.constt.bbsnav.mapper.BbsnavListMapper.processCounselor : 상담원 할당 저장/수정 * 2023.05.10 : 추가 - Jeong.Won.Je */ MERGE INTO AYA150 T1 USING DUAL ON ( T1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND T1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CONSTT_ID = #{CONSTT_ID} , CONSTT_NM_ENCPT = ( SELECT TT2.FLNM_ENCPT FROM SAA200 TT1 , SCA100 TT2 WHERE 1=1 AND TT1.USER_ID = #{CONSTT_ID} AND TT2.ENFSN_NO = TT1.ENFSN_NO AND TT2.DEL_YN = 'N' ) , REG_DT = SUBSTR(#{REG_DT}, 0, 8) , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{loginId} , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( INDEX_SN , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , CONSTT_ID , CONSTT_NM_ENCPT , REG_DT , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( AYA150_SQ01.NEXTVAL , #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} , #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} , #{CONSTT_ID} , ( SELECT TT2.FLNM_ENCPT FROM SAA200 TT1 , SCA100 TT2 WHERE 1=1 AND TT1.USER_ID = #{CONSTT_ID} AND TT2.ENFSN_NO = TT1.ENFSN_NO AND TT2.DEL_YN = 'N' ) , SUBSTR(#{REG_DT}, 0, 8) , #{loginId} , SYSDATE , #{loginId} , SYSDATE )
